profile.name: Talank Baral
profile.title: PhD Student in Computer Science
profile.bio: My research improves the speed and reliability of software testing and continuous integration (CI), combining empirical studies with program analysis and large language models (LLMs). I work on reproducing and repairing flaky tests, optimizing test execution and CI pipelines, and understanding how AI coding agents test the code they write. My research is motivated by two years of industry experience maintaining slow, brittle test pipelines.

projects.name: OptCD
projects.summary: A tool that finds directories a Maven build generates during a GitHub Actions run but never uses, traces each one to the plugin and workflow step responsible, and pushes a modified workflow that stops generating it. Presented at the ICSE 2025 Demonstrations Track; the underlying study appeared at ASE 2023.

projects.name: Chamena Griha
projects.summary: A food-ordering and payment web app for college canteens that removes the queue: students order from the menu, canteen staff serve and track orders, and college admins manage students. Later covered with BDD acceptance tests that run in CI.

projects.name: Gas Station Management System
projects.summary: A desktop point-of-sale and accounting system for a fuel station: instant and credit billing, credit-company accounts and payments, fuel stock and tank refills, daily closing reports, profit and loss, and receipt printing.

projects.name: Fish Hunt
projects.summary: A multiplayer Android game built with Unity: each player is a fish that eats food and smaller fish to grow, and the biggest fish when time runs out wins. Players host or join games over the local network or through Unity's relay.
